sectionsContent.title: Vectors Quiz, Version A

concept.summary: Write directly on this quiz. Sketch each vector problem, show your setup, and box your final answers with units.
keyIdeas: A direction has more than one correct name. Any correct form earns credit.
Calculation answers use two significant figures.

equations.note: components of vector A at its angle
equations.plain: Ax = A cos(angle)     Ay = A sin(angle)
Rx = Ax + Bx + Cx     Ry = Ay + By + Cy

equations.note: reference angle, then fix the quadrant from your sketch

sectionsContent.directions: Angles on the 0–360° scale are measured counterclockwise from east: east is 0°, north is 90°, west is 180°, south is 270°. Compass directions such as 35° north of east are measured from the axis named last. +x is east and +y is north.

questions.prompt: The direction 215° (0–360° scale, counterclockwise from east). Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: 215° is between 180° and 270°: past west, toward south 215° − 180° = 35° 215° − 360° = −145° same direction:  −145°  =  35° south of west  =  55° west of south

row: 215° is between 180° and 270°: past west, toward south
same direction:  −145°  =  35° south of west  =  55° west of south

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: The direction 40° north of west. Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: north of west is up and to the left: 180° − 40° = 140° 140° − 360° = −220° same direction:  140°  =  −220°  =  50° west of north

row: north of west is up and to the left: 180° − 40° = 140°

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: The direction −70° (negative means clockwise from east). Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: −70° + 360° = 290° 290° is 70° short of 360°: below east same direction:  290°  =  20° east of south  =  70° south of east

row: same direction:  290°  =  20° east of south  =  70° south of east

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: Pac-Man travels 45 m north and then 28 m west through the maze. Find his resultant displacement: magnitude and direction.
questions.solution: Components, Pythagorean theorem, then inverse tangent with the quadrant fixed from a sketch.

steps.note: that is measured from west; the vector points up and left

row: same direction:  −238°  =  32° west of north  =  58° north of west

steps.label: Grading (5): sketch 1 · R setup 1 · R and unit 1 · tan setup 1 · direction 1

questions.prompt: Sam Wilson flies the Falcon at 240 km/h at 40° north of east. A wind blowing toward 30° south of east at 65 km/h also acts on him. Find his resultant velocity: magnitude and direction.
questions.solution: Convert to 0-360, find components, add, then magnitude and direction.

row: P: 40° north of east = 40°     W: 30° south of east = 360° − 30° = 330°
same direction:  −333°  =  27° north of east  =  63° east of north

steps.label: Grading (5): components 2 · add components 1 · R 1 · direction 1
